summary: @ornikar/postcss-config preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: The package declares a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that fires unconditionally on `npm install`. setup.mjs is hex-identifier-obfuscated (`_0xNNNNNN` identifiers, string-key indirection) and downloads the Bun runtime from the oven-sh/bun GitHub releases, extracts and chmods it in a temp directory, then invokes it via `execFileSync` against a sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a ~727KB Bun-compiled bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header followed by a shuffled numeric string array) that is not reachable through normal `require()` of the package and has no relation to any documented postcss functionality. This is the alternate-runtime dropper pattern: an alien runtime is fetched at install time specifically to execute an opaque compiled blob shipped in the tarball, evading Node-based scanners. The package presents a benign postcss-config surface as cover.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
